Good News, Terrarians!
THE CROSSPLAY ERA FOR TERRARIA STARTS HERE
This feature has been years in the making and we're so pleased to be able to release to you Phase One of Crossplay. Starting today, for most people using the same Wi-Fi/wired network you will be able to play together with any device which has v1.4.6 Terraria, without a multiplayer subscription. Xbox, PlayStation, Switch, Android, Apple, PC, Mac; if you're on the same network, in most circumstances\* your games should be able see each other in the Local section of the NEW multiplayer menu.
\*Sometimes a local session isn't displaying in the multiplayer menu, let us know if this happens for you!
This first phase of Crossplay is all about making it easier to play together on the local network; to be able to play with friends on different platforms. And if you know how to set up your router, you can also send your friends your IP address to connect to you as a Server.
The second phase of Crossplay will be about making it even easier to join friends Online across the internet, regardless of platform. More details on this as we develop and improve Crossplay.
There is a new UI for Multiplayer on PC:
If your Platform Friend is hosting a world, or a local session is broadcasting, you can join it directly from this list. The Add Server button allows you to enter an IP address. Previously remembered servers will appear below friends.

**Does Crossplay include PC dedicated servers? Yes, but there are a few caveats:**
• If the PC server is an Online Server, connecting on PlayStation and Xbox will require an online subscription to connect. This is because you have to use Microsoft's and Sony's services to connect over the internet as per their online policy.
• Switch cannot connect to privately hosted dedicated servers, either Local or Online. This is due to security and safety restrictions required by Nintendo for the platform. This means that Switch will only successfully join a game running a player-hosted world on Switch or another platform.
• This does not apply to the Chinese mobile versions, as they use a different method for multiplayer.
If you are running a dedicated server on one of the server hosting services, the IP or web address can be manually input with the + Add Server button at the bottom of the multiplayer menu. Just type in the details. This will add an entry to the Server section which will remember the details for future sessions.
